name: 24-point star
description:
Slot-together star with 24 points: four identical six-pointed stars in four tilted planes (print 4x).
Print all four parts flat without supports (PLA, 0.2 mm layers). The parts cannot be slid together rigidly, so assembly bends the thin parts: slot two parts together like a classic two-part star, then push the third and fourth on while bending their points out of the way. Hang it with a thread tied around a point.
